verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents access-token-based API auth (airbyte-docs-17) and RBAC/multiple-workspace controls (airbyte-docs-29), which imply some ability to restrict access, but there is no documentation of issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials specifically for an AI agent's use (e.g., token scopes, permission grants tailored to agent workflows). Missing for 10: explicit scoped-token/permission-scoping API, documentation tying RBAC to agent credential issuance, and any hands-on confirmation of least-privilege agent access.
